tools.name: find_cat_toy_guide
tools.description: Find the most relevant PickCrest cat gear guide for a shopper need, including catio, renter, window, balcony, yard, fit, permission, indoor enrichment, puzzle feeders, automatic toys, or starter kits.

need.description: The shopper need or cat play style to match, for example: catio, renter, window, balcony, yard, no drill, cat ignores toys, bored indoor cat, puzzle feeder, automatic toy, or starter kit.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of guides. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: get_cat_toy_recommendation_flow
tools.description: Given a cat behavior, return a concise PickCrest recommendation flow: diagnose play style, read the best guide, then compare the safest matching affiliate search paths.

catBehavior.description: Observed behavior, for example: ignores toys, chases feathers, bats floor toys, food motivated, bored while I work, noisy apartment, rough player.

tools.name: get_page_shopping_paths
tools.description: Return affiliate shopping paths that fit the current PickCrest page, or a provided PickCrest URL/path. Useful after an agent lands on a guide and needs the matching retailer search links.

url.description: Optional PickCrest URL or path. Defaults to the current browser page.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of shopping paths. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: get_pickcrest_agent_manifest
tools.description: Return the main PickCrest agent-discovery URLs, policies, WebMCP tool names, and content limitations.

tools.name: get_top_cat_toy_affiliate_links
tools.description: Return PickCrest-approved Amazon affiliate search links for top cat toy categories matching a cat behavior, owner problem, or toy type. These are category/search links, not static prices or product claims.

need.description: Cat behavior or shopper need, for example: food motivated cat, quiet apartment toy, automatic toy, cat ignores toys, durable toy, or starter kit.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of affiliate search paths. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: list_cat_toy_guides
tools.description: List PickCrest cat gear and enrichment guides with URLs and topic tags so an agent can choose the right page for a shopper.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of guides. Defaults to all.
